citations.excerpt: The Evangelical or Protestant State Church of Prussia consists as it now stands of a union of the Lutherans and Calvinists, effected under royal pressure in 1817.

facts.value: Union of Lutheran and Reformed churches in Prussia under royal pressure, described by the king as an external union for shared communion and liturgy rather than a fusion of the two faiths.

citations.excerpt: consists as it now stands of a union of the Lutherans and Calvinists, effected under royal pressure in 1817. According to the king this was not a fusion of two faiths but an external union for mutual admission to the Eucharist and for the convenience of using the same liturgy

facts.value_before_verify: Union of Lutheran and Reformed churches in Prussia under the king, described by him as an external union for shared communion and liturgy rather than a fusion of the two faiths.
